exceptions.reason: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs, with no fixed picomatch release (latest 4.0.7). picomatch is reached only through Vite's build and dev-server tooling (vite, fdir, tinyglobby), a devDependency that is not part of the shipped UI bundle; the app serves the built files and does not run Vite. The glob patterns come from this repository's build configuration and Vite's defaults, not from users.
